subject.title: Slack: Include file attachment metadata in inbound message delivery to agents

question: What shared inbound attachment metadata shape should agents receive for Slack, Discord, Telegram, and future channel plugins?
rationale: The remaining work changes the channel-to-agent context contract and privacy boundary; a Slack-only field would be easy to add but likely become a competing source of truth.

options.title: Design shared metadata
options.body: Add a cross-channel attachment metadata field with stable names and privacy rules, then implement Slack as the first mapper.

options.title: Use Slack-only stopgap
options.body: Expose only Slack file metadata now, accepting a likely migration when other channels need the same shape.

options.title: Keep placeholders workflow
options.body: Treat current fileId placeholders plus download-file guidance as the supported workflow and close the metadata request after maintainer confirmation.

recommendation.title: Design shared metadata
recommendation.body: Add a cross-channel attachment metadata field with stable names and privacy rules, then implement Slack as the first mapper.

likelyOwner.reason: They are tied to the current media/context type history and were already pulled into the issue discussion for this contract decision.
